title: Well-known ports
intro: Knowledge-based questions — no shell session needed. Answer from memory or look up in `/etc/services`. Port numbers are the exact integers; protocol names are lowercase unless they are acronyms.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does SSH use?
questions.solutionMarkdown:
SSH listens on **TCP 22** by default ([RFC 4251](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4251)). Changing it to a high port reduces automated scan noise but is not a security control.

```
/etc/ssh/sshd_config: Port 22
```

questions.prompt: What port does DNS use for standard queries (both TCP and UDP)?
questions.solutionMarkdown: DNS uses **port 53** on both UDP (queries ≤ 512 bytes) and TCP (zone transfers and large responses). [RFC 7766](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7766) requires resolvers to support TCP.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does SMTP use for server-to-server mail relay (MTA-to-MTA)?
questions.solutionMarkdown: **TCP 25** is the standard MTA relay port ([RFC 5321](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321)). Port 587 is the mail submission port (MSA), and port 465 is SMTPS (legacy implicit TLS). Residential ISPs typically block outbound 25 to prevent spam.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does HTTPS use?
questions.solutionMarkdown: **TCP 443** ([RFC 2818](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2818)). Modern browsers also use **UDP 443** for QUIC/HTTP3. Traffic analysis: TLS ClientHello on 443 should show SNI for the destination hostname.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does the FTP control channel use?
questions.solutionMarkdown: FTP uses **TCP 21** for the control channel (commands and responses). The data channel uses TCP 20 in active mode or a negotiated high port in passive mode.

questions.prompt: What UDP port does SNMP use when polling agents?
questions.solutionMarkdown: SNMP agents listen on **UDP 161**. The trap/inform receiver (manager) listens on **UDP 162**. SNMPv3 added authentication and encryption; v1/v2c community strings travel in plaintext.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does BGP use?
questions.solutionMarkdown: BGP peers establish a TCP session on **port 179** ([RFC 4271](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4271)). Because it runs over TCP, BGP relies on the OS for reliable delivery rather than building its own retransmission logic.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) use by default?
questions.solutionMarkdown: **TCP 3389** (and UDP 3389 for UDP transport). RDP on 3389 is heavily targeted by brute-force scanners; exposing it directly to the internet without a VPN or NLA is high risk.

questions.prompt: What TCP port does PostgreSQL use by default?
questions.solutionMarkdown: PostgreSQL listens on **TCP 5432** by default. MySQL/MariaDB uses 3306, MSSQL uses 1433, Oracle uses 1521. Recognising these in packet captures identifies unencrypted database traffic.

questions.prompt: What UDP port does NTP use?
questions.solutionMarkdown: NTP uses **UDP 123** ([RFC 5905](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5905)). Misconfigured NTP servers have been abused for DRDoS amplification (monlist attacks). Blocking inbound UDP 123 from untrusted sources is standard hardening.

summaryMarkdown:
## Purpose

Port numbers are the first filter when reading firewall logs, pcap captures, or `ss`/`netstat` output. Recognising the service behind a port immediately narrows the investigation.

## Key reference groups

| Range | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0–1023 | Well-known / system ports (require root to bind) |
| 1024–49151 | Registered ports (IANA-assigned services) |
| 49152–65535 | Dynamic / ephemeral (OS-assigned for client connections) |

Full registry: [IANA Service Names and Port Numbers](https://www.iana.org/assignments/service-names-port-numbers/service-names-port-numbers.xhtml)
